relationships.subject: VHH DI-D
relationships.evidence_quote: Overall, these data confirm that VHH DI-D binds the target loop DIE3IR from different species and does not bind to the VHH FC5 scaffold.

relationships.subject: VHH DI-D
relationships.evidence_quote: VHH DI-D produced a significantly slower deactivation of hNav1.7 currents

relationships.subject: VHH DI-D
relationships.evidence_quote: At all tested concentrations, VHH DI-D reduced the pain behaviors induced by the injection of OD1

relationships.subject: OD1
relationships.evidence_quote: OD1 is a potent modulator of Nav1.7 (EC50 4.5 nm), with little effect on Nav1.3 and Nav1.5 (EC50 > 1 µm) and no effect on Nav1.2 and Nav1.8.

key_findings: Grafting a 70-aa hNav1.7 loop into a VHH CDR3 yielded VHH DI-D, which binds Nav1.7, slows deactivation and is selective over Nav1.1, 1.2 and 1.5
VHH DI-D reduced OD1-induced pain behaviors in mice (intraplantar and intrathecal); intrathecal PF05089771 had no effect
